name: Speed Duel: Twisted Nightmares Starter Deck [1st Edition]
cleanName: Speed Duel Twisted Nightmares Starter Deck 1st Edition
extDescription:
Each Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Speed Duel: Twisted Nightmares Starter Deck contains:
• 1 x 30-Card Bakura Deck
• 1 x 30-Card Marik Deck
• 4 Skill Cards (2 for Bakura and 2 for Marik)
• 2 Ultra Rare variant cards

name: Dark Necrofear
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 3 Fiend monsters from your GY. During the End Phase, if this card is in your GY because it was destroyed in your Monster Zone by an opponent's card and sent there this turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip this card to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster by this effect, take control of that monster.

name: Neck Hunter
extDescription: A fiend that wields a mean sickle and fires devastating beams from its eyes.

name: The Earl of Demise
extDescription: This gentlemanly creature is extremely wicked, feared by man and fiend alike.

name: That Which Feeds on Life
extDescription: A monster that feeds on the energy of other creatures.

name: Whiptail Crow
extDescription: Attacks from the skies with a whip-like tail.

name: The Gross Ghost of Fled Dreams
cleanName: The Gross Ghost of Fled Dreams
extDescription: This monster feeds on the dreams of an unwary sleeper, dragging the victim into eternal slumber.

name: Headless Knight
extDescription: A haunted spirit of a falsely accused knight who wanders in search of truth and justice.

name: Earthbound Spirit
extDescription: A vengeful creature formed by the spirits of fallen warriors, it drags any who dare approach it into the deepest bowels of the earth.

name: The Shadow Who Controls the Dark
cleanName: The Shadow Who Controls the Dark
extDescription: A shadow that dwells in the dark, paralyzing its opponents and rendering them harmless.

name: Gaap the Divine Soldier
extDescription: All monsters are changed to face-up Attack Position, also their battle positions cannot be changed. (Flip Effects are not activated.) Once per turn: You can reveal any number of Fiend-Type monsters in your hand; this card gains 300 ATK for each, until the End Phase.

name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
extDescription: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend monsters you control.

name: Puppet Master
extDescription: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can pay 2000 Life Points to target 2 Fiend monsters in your GY; Special Summon those targets, but they cannot attack this turn.

name: Lesser Fiend
extDescription:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
Banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card.

name: Twin-Headed Wolf
extDescription: When there is another face-up Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field, negate the effect of Flip Effect Monsters destroyed by this card as a result of battle.

name: Prometheus, King of the Shadows
extDescription: If this card is Normal Summoned: Banish 1 or more DARK monsters from your GY, and if you do, this card gains 400 ATK for each, until the end of this turn.

name: Lancer Archfiend
extDescription: Once per turn, when a monster you control declares an attack targeting a Defense Position monster your opponent controls, you can activate this effect. If you do, during this battle, if the ATK of the attacking monster is greater than the DEF of the Defense Position monster it battles, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Dark Mimic LV3
extDescription: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Draw 1 card, but if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Mimic LV1", draw 2 cards instead.

name: Dark Mimic LV1
extDescription:
FLIP: Draw 1 card.
During your Standby Phase: You can send this face-up card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Mimic LV3" from your hand or Deck.

name: Mask of Darkness
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 Trap in your GY; add that target to your hand.

name: Mad Reloader
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, and if you do, draw 2 cards.

name: Sword of Dark Destruction
extDescription: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK and loses 200 DEF.

name: Offerings to the Doomed
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target, also skip your next Draw Phase.

name: Twister
extDescription: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Dark Eruption
extDescription: Target 1 DARK monster with 1500 or less ATK in your GY; add that target to your hand.

name: Veil of Darkness
extDescription: During your Draw Phase, if you draw a DARK monster(s): You can reveal any number of them; send them to the GY, then you can draw 1 more card.

name: Allure of Darkness
extDescription: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 DARK monster from your hand, or, if you do not have any in your hand, send your entire hand to the GY.

name: Creeping Darkness
extDescription: Banish 2 DARK monsters from your Graveyard; add 1 Level 4 DARK monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Zoma the Spirit
extDescription: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Zombie/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 500). (This card is also still a Trap.) If this card Summoned this way is destroyed by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster that destroyed it.

name: Common Charity
extDescription: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 Normal Monster from your hand, or, if you have none, send your entire hand to the GY.

name: The Forceful Checkpoint
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Look at your opponent's hand, and if there is a Monster Card, negate the attack, then discard 1 monster from their hand (your choice).

name: Lava Golem
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) to your opponent's field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you Special Summon this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

name: Yaiba Robo
extDescription: A cubical machine equipped with cutting blades for shredding an opponent to mincemeat.

name: Brave Scizzar
extDescription: Armed with a mass of scissors, this monster can clip an enemy into any desired shape and size.

name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
extDescription: This monster has four different masks for four different attacks.

name: Gil Garth
extDescription: This steel-armored terror machine ruthlessly strikes down enemies with its giant katana.

name: Dark Prisoner
extDescription: This monster bends light to hide its image from the eyes of opponents.

name: Dokuroyaiba
extDescription: A boomerang with brains that will pursue a target to the ends of the earth.

name: Dark Lucius LV8
extDescription: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV6", your opponent's monsters that this card destroys by battle are removed from play, and their effects are negated.

name: Dark Lucius LV6
extDescription: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV4", the effects of your opponent's monsters that this card destroys by battle are negated. During your next Standby Phase after this card has negated your opponent's monster effect, by sending this card to the GY, Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV8" from your hand or Deck.

name: Dark Lucius LV4
extDescription: The effects of your opponent's monsters that this card destroys by battle are negated. During your next Standby Phase after this card destroys a monster by battle, by sending this card to the GY, Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV6" from your hand or Deck.

name: Legendary Fiend
extDescription: During each of your Standby Phases: This card gains 700 ATK.

name: Byser Shock
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned, return all Set cards on the field to their owner's respective hands.

name: Helpoemer
extDescription: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. If this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, this effect activates at the end of each of your opponent's Battle Phases: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Mefist the Infernal General
extDescription: When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, discard 1 card randomly from your opponent's hand.

name: Lady Assailant of Flames
extDescription: FLIP: Banish the top 3 cards of your Deck; inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

name: Viser Des
extDescription: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; during your third Standby Phase after this effect's activation, destroy that monster. This card cannot be destroyed by battle while the targeted monster is on the field.

name: Newdoria
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Dark Jeroid
extDescription: When this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 800 ATK.

name: Drillago
extDescription: If the only cards your opponent controls are face-up monsters with 1600 or more ATK, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Bowganian
extDescription: During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

name: Tribute to The Doomed
extDescription: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

name: Level Up!
extDescription: Send 1 face-up "LV" monster you control to the GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck that is listed in the sent monster's text, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

name: Creature Seizure
extDescription: Each player gives their opponent control of 1 of their monsters (controller's choice). You must choose a face-up Normal Monster.

name: Faustian Bargain
extDescription: Send 1 Special Summoned monster on either side of the field to the Graveyard and Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand.

name: Supply Squad
extDescription: Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: Draw 1 card.

name: Rope of Life
extDescription: When a monster(s) is destroyed by battle and sent to your GY: Discard your entire hand (min.1), then target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon it, and if you do, it gains 800 ATK.

name: Nightmare Wheel
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. That monster must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Coffin Seller
extDescription: Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

name: Metal Reflect Slime
extDescription: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua-Type/WATER/Level 10/ATK 0/DEF 3000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) This card cannot attack.

name: Prideful Roar
extDescription: During damage calculation, if your monster battles an opponent's monster with a higher ATK: Pay Life Points equal to the difference in ATK; your monster gains ATK equal to that difference +300, during damage calculation only.

name: Santa Claws
extDescription: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) to your opponent's field in Defense Position, by Tributing 1 monster they control. If Summoned this way, once, during the End Phase of this turn: You can draw 1 card.

name: Magical Stone Excavation
extDescription: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

name: Inner Conflict
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can pay half your LP and take control of 1 monster your opponent controls until the End Phase, but it cannot attack directly this turn.

name: Into the Darkness Below
extDescription:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can discard 1 Normal Fiend Monster, then use 1 of the following Skills.
• Draw 1 card, also flip this card over.
• If you have 4 or more Fiend Normal Monsters with different names in your GY, add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand, also flip this card over.

name: Shadow Reborn
extDescription: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can pay half your LP and Special Summon 1 monster from either GY, but your opponent takes no battle damage this turn.

name: Twisted Personality
extDescription:
Each time a player loses LP, place 1 counter on this card (max. 3). Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can use 1 of the following Skills.
• Remove 2 counters from this card, then discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
• Remove 3 counters from this card, then destroy 1 face-up card your opponent controls.
